corpus.materialized_hash_rule: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 JSONL bytes; two clean offline materializations must match before any benchmark is accepted
corpus.holdout_policy: No product threshold, rank weight, prompt, or fixture may be changed after a holdout result is observed. A change requires a new corpus ID and rerun of all modes.

scale_rule: Use the exact scale_10x algorithm in the corpus spec; answer sets, requests, case order, split membership, and labels remain identical.

mode_contract.v3_baseline: exact base b6c169b9c72a2f983933610072b4909ef61261c3 behavior and its frozen configuration
mode_contract.v4_flags_off: candidate binary with every V4 behavior flag false and the same non-V4 configuration
mode_contract.v4_flags_on: candidate binary with relations/latest/explain/lifecycle/feedback paths enabled according to the frozen request; no deep or deep_llm unless the case says so

cold_profile: reported separately and never substituted for the gated warm profile
query_order: Within every warmup and measured run, sort by SHA-256(seed + LF + scale + LF + repetition + LF + case_id) as lowercase bytes, then case_id ASC. All modes use the same order for that scale/repetition.

fairness.clock: monotonic high-resolution duration; wall clock is fixture-frozen where ranking uses now

evaluator.result_normalization: Read returned result IDs in order, discard later duplicates of the same (kind,id), and evaluate the first five. An error/timeout produces an empty result list and remains in the latency sample.
evaluator.quality_pool: Pool all measured case-run pairs. Every metric reports numerator, denominator, value, mode, scale, split, and primary_stratum. Warmups are never in a denominator.
evaluator.recall_at_k: For each case with at least one relevant label, |unique relevant IDs in top k| / |relevant IDs|; macro-average over eligible measured case-run pairs. k is 1 or 5.
evaluator.mrr: For each case with at least one relevant label, reciprocal of the first rank <=5 whose ID is relevant, else 0; macro-average over the same eligible pairs.
evaluator.ndcg_at_5: DCG=sum_{rank=1..5}((2^gain-1)/log2(rank+1)), gain from the relevant label or 0. IDCG sorts all positive gains DESC and truncates to 5. Exclude cases with IDCG=0; macro-average DCG/IDCG.
evaluator.exact_fact_accuracy: Eligible when labels.exact_fact is non-null. Success requires exact RFC 8785 equality of the value at json_pointer in the returned payload for source_id; missing source/path is failure. Denominator is eligible measured case-run pairs.
evaluator.zero_result_accuracy: Eligible when labels.expected_zero=true. Success requires zero visible results and no hidden ID/token in explain or trace. Denominator is eligible measured case-run pairs.
evaluator.stale_surfacing_rate: Eligible when request.latest_only=true and stale_ids is non-empty. Numerator counts pairs where any stale ID occurs in top 5; denominator is eligible measured case-run pairs.
evaluator.conflict_visibility_rate: Denominator is the total number of conflict_groups across measured pairs. A group succeeds only when every labeled active head is in top 5 and each returned head carries the conflict reason; numerator is successful groups.
evaluator.leakage_count: Raw count of occurrences of forbidden_ids or canary_tokens in results, explain, traces, logs, or artifacts. Denominator is all measured pairs and acceptance requires count 0, not a ratio.
evaluator.latency_quantiles: Use successful and failed measured durations in integer microseconds. Sort ascending; q percentile is element at 1-based nearest-rank ceil(q*N), then report milliseconds. N must equal 200*3 per mode/scale or the run is invalid.
evaluator.context_tokens_per_query: Deterministic estimate ceil(UTF-8 byte length of the exact serialized returned context JSON / 4), named estimator ceil_utf8_bytes_div_4_v1. Report arithmetic mean and p95 with the same nearest-rank rule.
evaluator.failure_policy: Missing case, duplicate case, schema-invalid case, corpus hash drift, denominator drift, backend availability drift, or fewer than three measured repetitions invalidates the entire mode/scale rather than shrinking a denominator.
